meta.claim: AI will replace all junior software developers by 2030

evo.note: Score reflects monolithic claim extraction over all report sections including Mitigation Strategies — sections that are inherently ungrounded by design, artificially depressing the score.

revamped.note: Score derived from NLI-verified perspective clusters. Each cluster survived pairwise NLI entailment scoring (≥0.60 threshold). Primary source verdict provides an additional fidelity signal absent in Evo.

evo.note: Evo retrieves articles in a fixed 30-day window via SerpAPI. No mechanism exists to reach archival content beyond this window.

revamped.note: Revamped retrieves from GDELT, Common Crawl, and Tavily across 5 predefined historical phases spanning ~365 days. This archival depth is structurally impossible in the legacy system.

evo.note: Evo does not perform NLI-based perspective clustering. All articles are collapsed into a single LLM narrative, masking minority viewpoints and counter-narratives.

cluster_labels: Tech optimists: AI augments rather than replaces developers
Labour economists: AI accelerating displacement of entry-level roles
Policy advocates: urgent reskilling investment needed
revamped.note: Revamped identified 3 NLI-verified perspective clusters via DeBERTa-v3-small pairwise entailment scoring. Each cluster represents a structurally distinct viewpoint in the media ecosystem, enabling multi-sided analysis.

evo.note: Evo has no event-correlation capability. Narrative shifts are identified visually but cannot be automatically linked to verifiable real-world events. Score is structurally 0.

correlated_events.event: GitHub Copilot GA launch sparks major productivity vs job-loss debate.
Goldman Sachs AI displacement report released — 300M jobs at risk.

revamped.note: Score = GDELT event coverage × mean plausibility. 2/2 inflection points were correlated to verifiable real-world events via GDELT query + LLM plausibility scoring.

verdict: Evo-Revamped outperforms the legacy Evo system by 127.7% on the composite evaluation metric, driven by its multi-source archival retrieval (GDELT/Common Crawl), NLI-based perspective clustering, and real-world event correlation — capabilities entirely absent in the legacy system.
